receiver_tn_status: Measured no-TWPA configuration; conditional application to all three modes, not measured per mode/run.
rf_gain_status: Thesis Eq. 5.33: RF chain including additional FET, before downconversion. Do not cascade again with the nominal 143 dB chain.

source_notes.cavity: Thesis Table 6.1; QL=Q0/(1+kappa1+kappa2); intrinsic wall bath couples to measured output port 2.
source_notes.temperature: Run 680 observed AVS T15 median (11 observations); not a fitted noise temperature. Thesis ~30 mK is a separate scenario.
source_notes.sampling_and_filter_cutoff: Thesis sections 5.1 and 5.4.3. LPF cutoff documented; Butterworth order/shape is assumed.
source_notes.adc_range: Use the scientific product's configured input_range_v; operational scaling, not independent hardware calibration.
source_notes.absolute_calibration: Mode-dependent numerical kz(f), calibration covariance and run-matched receiver noise are missing. Absolute ADC prediction remains nominal.
